notes.subject: to the stouthearted exiles
notes.rationale: Verse 13 continues Yawe's direct speech begun in 46:12, addressed to those far from righteousness.

notes.subject: תשועתי / תשועה
notes.rationale: 'My rescue' and 'rescue' repeat the same noun, a framing echo lost in Bambara by the possessive difference alone.

notes.subject: לישראל תפארתי
notes.rationale: KJV 'for Israel my glory' (apposition) vs BSB 'adorn Israel with My splendor' (תפארתי as what is given); rendered here as a second gift in parallel with 'rescue'.

translation: N bɛ n ka tiɲɛ-ɲuman na surun, a tɛna jan, ani n ka lakana tɛna latugu; n bɛna lakana di Tsiyon (Siyoŋ) kɔnɔ, ani Israyɛl (Isirayɛli) ma, n ka ɲɛjɛ.

tokens.gloss: N bɛ n ka … na surun
